reason: Everything I do ends up in Jurnal or Accurate, and a Google Sheet with no invoice number, PPN or NPWP columns just means I re-key it all anyway. Collecting receipts is only half the pain; getting them into the books is the other half, and this does not touch it.
objection: No export to Jurnal or Accurate and no tax fields, so it adds a step instead of removing one. Also 5 groups per account is too few when I have more clients than that.
would_change_my_mind: A direct import file for Jurnal or Accurate with invoice number, PPN and NPWP fields filled in.
